pinned_artifacts.role: E39 markup-tag frequency census — per-dict per-tag counts over all 44 csl-orig v02 dictionaries (FAIR Release #1 dataset)
E40 pairwise headword-overlap + Jaccard matrix over the 15-dict union — 105 dictionary pairs (FAIR Release #1 dataset)
companion output of the E40 builder — per-dict headword and unique counts
FAIR Release #1 deposit package — metadata, provenance, licence, Zenodo deposit JSON, status

source_pins.source_path: v02/<code>/<code>.txt (the 44 main-text files, one per dictionary)
source_pins.pin_rule: the checkout state named by data/MARKUP_TAG_CENSUS_CSLORIG_2026.md as the census input (commit dated 2026-07-04). NOT re-derivable by rev-list --before: origin/main had already advanced to 7985b701 by the 2026-07-11 run date, and the run used this explicit checkout. Re-derived mechanically by digesting the 44 v02/<code>/<code>.txt blobs at the pin commit.
source_pins.sha256_form: set-digest:census — sha256 over the LF bytes of the path-sorted line sequence 'v02/<code>/<code>.tx<tab><sha256-of-lf-canonical-blob>' (one line per file, newline-terminated), files enumerated as v02/<code>/<code>.txt at the pin commit

source_pins.pin_rule: git rev-list -1 --before=2026-07-11T00:00:00Z <this repo> -- HeadwordLists/union/union_headwords.tsv (the consumed input's last change before the 2026-07-11 overlap run); re-derivation verified to return the pin commit

output_digests.note: The release asset files ARE the pinned artifacts (byte-identical), so each block restates recomputed values so a consumer verifies without trusting the pinned file beyond its own pin digest. rows = data rows excluding the single header line.

config.selection_rule: the repo's repo-wide release tag v1.144.164; the envelope wraps the FAIR Release #1 data exports that ship inside the tracked tree — the three TSVs are unchanged since their 2026-07-11 landing commits (66d0f1c3, 79338e73) and were verified byte-identical at the tag and at HEAD
config.digest_form: sha256 over the LF-canonical form (CRLF normalised; this repo's .gitattributes already enforces eol=lf, so working-tree bytes equal canonical bytes)
config.rows_convention: rows = data rows excluding the single header line
config.declared_tolerances: Rebuild at the PINS reproduces every declared digest exactly (verified 2026-09-10: census rerun against a git-archive extraction of csl-orig 78cbb257 v02 reproduces a8ebc33e byte-for-byte; overlap rerun against the pinned union blob reproduces 60d5f30c byte-for-byte). Rebuild against CURRENT upstream differs and is not a defect: csl-orig v02 has drifted past 78cbb257 since the run (working-clone rerun yields 0ac35fc9), and the in-repo union_headwords.tsv was refreshed post-build (de986505, 2026-09-05, H4075: 323,425 → 323,422 data rows) — the pinned inputs are authoritative for this release.

tool_versions.builders: data/markup_tag_census.py + data/headword_overlap_matrix.py, stdlib-only, committed beside the outputs
tool_versions.envelope_checker: scripts/envelope_check.py — stdlib-only, Python >= 3.9, --envelope required, --source-root to override sibling-clone lookup
tool_versions.model_note: no model-generated content enters the datasets; the envelope's prose was authored by H4255 (OxAlpha, zai-coding-plan/glm-5.3-flash) and every number in it is recomputed by scripts/envelope_check.py
